preservedOrdering: Current auth/source/owner locks and all reservation/refusal guards remain in original order. First copy is acquired at original first accessor point, not before authority/budget checks; later digest factory/canonicalization remains original point.

Actual requestId/kind/attempt/payload/wire bytes/2048 allowance/schema pins/plan revision/clock deadline/hard deadline/budget reservation/SQL/CAS unchanged. No provider/native/model call or throw is moved outside its original stage.

Normal closed-contract canonical/schema/business refusals retain their original first guard and timing point. Eliminating one duplicate pure deepCopy reduces allocation work; no promise about preserving a hypothetical VM out-of-memory failure caused exclusively by that removed allocation.
